title: Fix MemoryIndex race conditions from unsynchronized dictionaries
description: MemoryIndex uses plain Dictionary<> and HashSet<> with zero synchronization. Public dictionaries expose mutable references. Concurrent Add/Remove/Rebuild calls cause ArgumentException or index corruption. Replace with ConcurrentDictionary or add ReaderWriterLockSlim, make dictionaries private, expose query methods (GetByTag, GetByReference, GetById). Also clean up empty HashSet entries left in dictionaries after removal (gradual memory leak). Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P0-002
